# 1103 — Group metadata allowlist value is never coerced

Build-start snapshot (batch order #4 of 6). Builds on #1101/#1102/#1098 (helper landed at `cc745132`).
Full approved plan + challenge dispositions live on maestro Inbox item 1103.

## Objective
Coerce `group.metadata["allowed_redirect_urls"]` through the same rules `settings.get(kind="list")` uses,
before it reaches the matcher; drop a non-coercible value as an unusable SOURCE with one suppressed signal.
Fixes: a string silently shattering into char-entries; a non-iterable (int/bool) 500ing the public /begin.
